entry.unit: degrees between the sun the wear layers' shade used and the scene's sun lamp
entry.source: Lessons round (23 October 2026): the wear layers decided which sides stay sheltered and damp as if the sun stood at 135 degrees compass and 45 up, whatever the scene's own sun (garden plan 30 section 5 note). They now read the scene's one sun lamp; the kit's own sun stands 10 degrees lower than that fallback, so 20 leaves room for it
